source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/<id>/overview, one page per model; the id, release date and context window are copied from there, and so is the purpose line of each line's newest model, the only one a notice ever shows; a legacy model's purpose line is a short paraphrase of its page
how_updated: By a pull request to this repository. The launcher fast-forwards its checkout before every event, so every tenant learns of a newer model at their next turn. The notice compares the session's model against the newest in the same line, by release date; a model that is not listed here is not compared.
